composition: House foundations, Ionic columns, and the palace hill · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: On the flat site of ancient Pella, low stone foundations follow a street grid, and a few Ionic columns of a peristyle still stand. The palace hill, with a long colonnade, closes the view to the north. The sky is clear, about 8.2°C. The ruins are empty and unlit. No mosaic pavement is the subject.
